eDelivery - Software update
Introduction
The user can update to the latest software in two ways:

As part of the product lifecycle management, GE regularly analyzes and integrates software updates from our third party vendors into our products. These are typically released as part of regular updates or software releases.
Through the GE service platform on the ultrasound system. This requires Insite RSvP connectivity. See 'Software update via Insite Remote Service Platform (RSvP)' on page 7-81 .
Download the latest software from an end-user portal to a local storage location and install it on the ultrasound system. See 'Software update via End-User Portal' on page 7-87 .
7-80 LOGIQ e – Basic Service Manual 5937432-1EN Rev. 4
eDelivery - Software update
Software update via Insite Remote Service Platform (RSvP)
Software update for the system may become available for download and installation through the GE Service platform.

Users must have administrator rights to go to download and installation page. A user who is not logged in as ADM (administrator) will see the notification of an available update, but not be allowed to go to the download page.
NOTE: Before installation, user should login with the ADM account, otherwise there will be pop-up message to remind. Only after logging in with the ADM account, user has access to install software.
Figure 7-52. Access Denied
Please backup presets and patient data when updates system software (see 'Backup and Restore Database, Preset Configurations and Images' on page 4-44).
CAUTION

Remote software download should not change user presets or affect customer database; however, it is always best practice to ensure patient data and preset are backed up before proceeding with any software installation.
NOTE: Be sure to end exam before software update.
NOTE: Please allow approximately half an hour for complete software download (the download time may vary due to network connection speed).
NOTE: Please allow approximately half an hour for complete installation.
NOTE: Software upgrade through the GE HealthCare platform may not be available in all markets.
LOGIQ e – Basic Service Manual 7-81
Diagnostics/Troubleshooting
Software download and installation
Click on the eDelivery Download package.
Press the notification icon to display the service menu, Click Download to check the update.
Available software updates are displayed in the list. If you want to refresh the query for available updates, press Refresh .
Figure 7-53. Package
Figure 7-54. Service Notification
Figure 7-55. Refresh
7-82 LOGIQ e – Basic Service Manual 5937432-1EN Rev. 4
eDelivery - Software update
Software download and installation (continued)
Select the desired software update and press Download to download the update package, or Click to exit the window.
During the software download process, the status will be displayed as "Downloading". You can press Pause to suspend the download or press Cancel to abort the download.
Figure 7-56. Download or Exit
Figure 7-57. Downloading
LOGIQ e – Basic Service Manual 7-83
Diagnostics/Troubleshooting
Software download and installation (continued)
Figure 7-58. Canceled
When the download is in progress, press the Pause button to suspend the download process.
When the download process is suspended, press the Resume button to recover the download process from the point where it is stopped.
If there is an error during the downloading process, press the Retry button to recover the download process from the beginning.
7-84 LOGIQ e – Basic Service Manual 5937432-1EN Rev. 4
eDelivery - Software update
Software download and installation (continued)
When the download process finishes, the software is ready to be installed in the ultrasound system. Log the ADM account, Click Yes to start the installation.
Figure 7-59. Start Installation
Figure 7-60. Install
NOTE: Please allow enough time for ultrasound device to reboot automatically to complete the installation process.
LOGIQ e – Basic Service Manual 7-85
Diagnostics/Troubleshooting
Software download and installation (continued)
The system will reboot several times to complete the installation.

After software installation is complete and the system is rebooted, a Reminder after Installation window will appear. This is to remind the user to manually restore configurations if the system has related settings backed up before the software update. Contact your on-site IT staff if available.
Click OK to confirm the installation is completed. Ensure that the entire system functions normally after service procedures.
NOTE: DO NOT power off the system during the software installation.
NOTE: A typical full installation may take up to 60 minutes.
NOTE: A typical application software installation may take up to 20 to 30 minutes.
Figure 7-61. Reminder after Installation
7-86 LOGIQ e – Basic Service Manual 5937432-1EN Rev. 4
eDelivery - Software update
Software update via End-User Portal
Customers entitled to eDelivery updates get a customer account to download software within the End-User Portal.

Users are created for the account based on e-mail addresses provided by the customer at the point of sale. These e-mail addresses are the log-in credential for the End-User Portal along with a temporary password provided to the user through e-mail. When logging in to the End-User Portal the first time, the user is prompted to change the password and enter a secret question and answer for password retrieval.
Follow the below instructions to download software from the portal:
Log on to the portal website which is provided to end user via a welcome email:
https://gehealthcare.flexnetoperations.com/flexnet/ operationsportal
Log in using the user name (e-mail) and password.
Figure 7-62. Login Window
LOGIQ e – Basic Service Manual 7-87
Diagnostics/Troubleshooting
Software update via End-User Portal (continued)
The License & Delivery Portal dashboard is displayed. Multiple downloadable packages will be displayed as a link under Your Downloads .
Click the link to enter the Download Packages page. Downloadable packages with links will be listed. Click on the desired link to enter the Downloads page.
Figure 7-63. Your Downloads
Figure 7-64. Select link
7-88 LOGIQ e – Basic Service Manual 5937432-1EN Rev. 4
eDelivery - Software update
Software update via End-User Portal (continued)
Right click on the "File Name" link, select "Save Link As... " to download the file to your storage device (a readable and writeable USB flash driver with enough capacity).
NOTE: Multiple files may be downloaded on one device.
Figure 7-65. Save Link As...
Load the downloaded software on the ultrasound system from the selected storage location. Refer to See 'Loading the Software' on page 7-90 for more information.
LOGIQ e – Basic Service Manual 7-89
Diagnostics/Troubleshooting
Loading the Software
To load a software onto the LOGIQ e,
Power off the LOGIQ e.
Insert the USB Flash Drive into a USB port.
NOTE: Ensure that the system is USB Device Enabled.
Power on the LOGIQ e. The software program files will be recognized automatically, select Install SW... on the Start Application screen.
Figure 7-66. Select Install SW...

NOTE: If by accident you try to load a software that is not compatible with the software on the LOGIQ e, error messages will indicate "The package present in media is not compatible. Please contact GE Service" and "Software installation is not started".
Click OK on StartLoader screen. Then select the package you want to install, and click INSTALL to start installation.
When the installation is complete, the system will reboot automatically.
Remove the USB stick from the ultrasound device.
The whole installation is completed once system reboots.
NOTE: Installation time depends on the type of update. No action is
needed until the installation is completed.
7-90 LOGIQ e – Basic Service Manual 5937432-1EN Rev. 4
eDelivery - Software update
Reload the Software
Reload Software provides specific software versions for users to reload.
NOTE: Users are required to be logged into the system as administrators (ADM) in order be granted access.
To reload the software onto the LOGIQ e:
Press Utility -> System -> About, click Reload Software to enter the operation page.
Figure 7-67. Select Reload Software
LOGIQ e – Basic Service Manual 7-91
Diagnostics/Troubleshooting
Reload the Software (continued)
Select the software version needed, then click OK .
By default, current installed software version will be displayed, user can reload current software version to rollback software changes to the initial installed state.
After a new full software package is installed, current version will be displayed as previous version, user can select to reload current version or previous version.
NOTE: After rollback to previous software version, the "Current/ Previous" reload options will alternate.
Figure 7-68. Select the current version
Figure 7-69. Select the previous version
7-92 LOGIQ e – Basic Service Manual 5937432-1EN Rev. 4
eDelivery - Software update
Reload the Software (continued)
A pop-up message will appear to remind user to continue or cancel the reload process. Click Yes to start reloading software or No to cancel.
Figure 7-70. Pop-up message
The operator or service engineer should confirm the system status after software update with eDelivery function.
WARNING
